boundary: This is an intrinsic exact description of the displayed 2,880-member signature-resolution orbit. It does not classify stabilizers of every signature-resolution orbit.
theorem: The order-nine setwise stabilizer of the 6T128+3T96 signature resolution is elementary abelian C3 x C3, not cyclic C9. Its three point-orbits are two T128 triangles and one T96 triangle. On the six T128 signatures, inner product 74 is exactly 2K3 and inner product 70 is exactly K3,3; all 21 remaining pairs have inner product 78.
